contract.runtimeMapping: Every authored scene needs a justified mapping or an explicit documented reuse decision before integration.
contract.visualFamilyRule: Candidate families are inventory hypotheses only; they are not approved art-pairs and do not authorize generation.
contract.provenanceRule: Every future file needs stable asset ID, dimensions, creation method, source/license, transformations, checksum and approval state.

coverage.reasonForUnknownArtCount: No approved scene-by-scene art inventory exists; one authored scene is not assumed to equal one art-pair.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Leo places a pier photograph on the archive table; Nika turns it face down and continues the inventory.
materialVisualRequirements: Nika keeps the photograph under her control
working distance between Nika and Leo
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: The photograph is a story-critical prop and the first EP3 visual beat; no existing accepted asset proves the required scene mapping.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Leo proposes the west-wing survey and Nika defines the professional boundary and reporting obligation.
materialVisualRequirements: Nika and Leo remain in a professional arrangement
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: Same archive setting and cast as ep3_old_photo, but the brief and documents may require a distinct readable prop state; art direction must decide whether one family can carry both cues.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika carries a torch, tablet and question list while Leo measures a doorway and records the staff passage constraint.
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: First material survey location and operational constraint; requires a spatially legible composition rather than archive-room reuse.

title.en: The Line That Cannot Be Erased

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: A proposed partition crosses the staff niche; Leo weighs sending the report against requesting the complete brief.
materialVisualRequirements: plan with the new partition line
operational conflict visible without UI text baked into art
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: Same west-wing location as the survey, but the partition line and operational niche are a new story-critical visual state; reuse is acceptable only if the changed prop/action remains legible.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Giulia walks them through the kitchen, laundry and service stairs with the real cart route; Leo replaces the word unused with the factual route.
materialVisualRequirements: three extra turns must be compositionally understandable
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: New cast member and operational route make this a distinct scene family; no existing EP1/EP2 asset proves the required action.

title.en: A Report Instead of a Gesture

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika stays in the office and asks for the full report through Matteo; Leo sends materials without holding her in the conversation.
materialVisualRequirements: Nika at work rather than romance framing
report transmission or incoming report cue
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: Office setting can likely carry adjacent report beats, but the absence of a current asset mapping means reuse is only a candidate pending cue-to-frame review.

title.en: A Page That Can Be Checked

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika attaches the printed report to the work log and records the operational conflict without turning it into a claim about the past.
materialVisualRequirements: evidence remains documentable rather than accusatory
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: Same office/report chain as ep3_survey_decline_response; a distinct document state may be handled by a meaningful variant if readability and cue mapping survive runtime framing.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika and Leo discuss the eight-year silence with a work folder and pier photograph between them.
materialVisualRequirements: two chairs in the villa office
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: The old photograph returns as a story-critical prop and the emotional beat changes from work report to accountability; reuse from report scenes is not assumed.

title.en: What He Is Willing to Do

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika records Leo's promise beside a report deadline; she does not promise to answer it with the same intimacy.
materialVisualRequirements: no visual implication of consent beyond authored choice
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: Adjacent accountability beat may reuse the prior office family if the written promise and boundary remain visible; final decision belongs in the art brief.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Leo lays plans on the west-wing floor; Nika photographs the mark and records Aurea as a working hypothesis, not a fact.
materialVisualRequirements: Nika photographing without taking the original
Aurea mark must be a readable but unconfirmed clue
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: The floor-plan arrangement and evidence status are materially different from the earlier doorway survey; a distinct composition is justified.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika opens the incoming-mail log and asks Leo to show the order appendix on her screen instead of retelling it from memory.
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: Archive location returns, but the screen/document verification is a new story-critical prop state; reuse from the old-photo family is not presumed.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika compares the matching appendix copies and records that the document is still subject to full verification.
materialVisualRequirements: distinction between drawing lead and verified terms
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: The response follows the same verification action; a meaningful document-state variant may be sufficient if it preserves the evidence distinction.

title.en: Do Not Protect Anyone from the Truth

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Matteo takes the copy only after Nika permits it; Leo stays by the door and does not decide whom she gives the folder to.
materialVisualRequirements: Matteo receives evidence only with permission
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: New cast count and permission-sensitive handover are materially different from two-person office beats.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika records the handover and next inspection in the journal; the team receives conditions after Matteo's review.
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: The office may be reused, but the journal and post-disclosure state must remain legible and distinct from the confrontation.

sceneInventory.narrativeCue: Nika writes Aurea beside the survey date as a fact with a recorded verification level; Leo turns on the west-wing light while Bianca is present in the transition beat.
materialVisualRequirements: knowledge is recorded without forcing romance meaning
sceneInventory.reuseRationale: The cast and transition role differ from the two-person office aftermath; the final EP3 handoff needs its own composition unless art direction proves a safe reuse.

nextRequiredActions: Approve or revise candidate family grouping with a source-bound art brief; do not treat candidate families as final art-pair count.
Create exact current-head dual-format manifests only after the scene/family decisions are accepted.
Before any generation, use a fresh run-scoped CEOS capability challenge and official producer route in the actual producing context.
After real files exist, verify each portrait and landscape PNG with new receipts, then integrate mappings and run current-runtime QA.
Do not repeat EP2 acceptance or alter accepted EP2 bytes.
